fundamentals.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, packages, tests, and sells integrated circuits and other semiconductor devices in Taiwan, China, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Japan, the United States, and internationally. It provides various wafer fabrication processes, such as processes to manufacture complementary metal- oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) logic, mixed-signal, radio frequency, embedded memory, bipolar CMOS mixed-signal, and others. The company also involved in providing customer and engineering support services; manufacturing of masks; investment in technology start-up companies; research, designing, developing, manufacturing, packaging, testing, and sale of color filters; and investment activities. Its products are used in high performance computing, smartphones, Internet of things, automotive, and digital consumer electronics. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

judgment.summary: A highly profitable, rapidly growing semiconductor manufacturer with a strong balance sheet and favorable analyst sentiment.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat estimates by 4.7%; next earnings date is 2026-07-16.
positives: Revenue growth 35.1% YoY and earnings growth 58.4% YoY indicate strong top and bottom-line expansion.
Gross margin 61.9%, operating margin 58.1%, and profit margin 46.5% demonstrate exceptional profitability.
Return on equity at 36.2% and return on assets at 17.3% show efficient use of capital.
Forward P/E of 21.97 is attractive given the high growth rates and PEG ratio of 1.35.
Total cash of $3.38T provides substantial liquidity, and free cash flow of $719.16B is robust.
negatives: Price/Book of 65.64 suggests a high valuation relative to book value.
Debt/Equity of 18.45%, while not excessive, indicates some leverage.
Beta of 1.25 suggests higher volatility than the broader market.

news.paragraph: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSM) is seeing significant investor attention following its 2nm breakthrough, which is reshaping AI compute and investor expectations. The CEO has highlighted long-term AI demand, and the company forecasts sustained AI chip demand, with recent earnings beating estimates. This positive news flow, coupled with strong analyst sentiment, suggests continued momentum for TSM.
